title: List possible Extension options on CLI
description:
Both tshark and Wireshark silently accept unknown or malformed 'X' eXtension options.

This MR introduces validation of 'X' options. If an unknown or superficially malformed 'X' option is seen a list of extension options is displayed on the CLI and the program (tshark/Wireshark) exits.

notes.body: I agree with the comment. There's enough code in here that duplicating it would be unwise. The wsutil directory could be a good place for this common code.
The for loop will stop iterating on the first "name == NULL".
